text_block_list.text:
They're heading into the third corner
now! Will
anyone take the lead from
here?

(...I can hear the other runners breathing.
I can
feel the heat of competition on my
skin.)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Wh-what the heck is up with her? For a split second... she looked like a monster!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Now this is interesting! I have to beat her now!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Thanks. But it's not good enough. I can
get even
better.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Heh. ...So what's next? Hurry up and tell
me,
before this feeling fades.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: What should Нарита Брайан aim for next?

What comes to mind is a prestigious
title, one
that can only be challenged
once in a lifetime.

The fiercely competitive title of Triple
Crown
champion.
choice_data_list: Want to go for the Classic Triple Crown?

text_block_list.text: Then, first up is the Satsuki Sho.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
And so, Нарита Брайан and I set our sights
on the
Satsuki Sho.
